headline: 作家邦妮葛瑞爾辭世
context: 美裔英籍作家兼文化評論人邦妮．葛瑞爾（Bonnie Greer）辭世，享壽 77 歲。她曾在 BBC2 的文化節目《Late Review》與《Newsnight Review》擔任犀利的常態來賓，創作也橫跨小說、劇本、回憶錄與紀錄片等領域。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The writer and editor shares memories of a creative powerhouse who was generous with her time and expertise Bonnie Greer, writer and cultural commentator, dies aged 77 Bonnie Greer personified courage, humour, principle and generosity. Before knowing her in person, I met her work. Her 1994 debut novel Hanging by Her Teeth – about a Black American woman travelling through the US and Europe in search of her father – was sent to me for endorsement by its publisher, and I commented unhesitatingly: “Writing with sharpness, wit and poignancy, Bonnie Greer gathers the sequestered memories behind one Black woman’s bitter-sweet blues.” The scope of Bonnie’s own life is beyond anything fictional, encompassing highs and lows, triumphs and challenges, her trajectory starting in the West Side of Chicago and ending up navigating iconic areas of London – whether Holland Park or Covent Garden or Soho – as if to the manor born. It was an honour to become her friend, sharing many a good time, offering a consoling shoulder if needed. An added bonus was to meet her husband David Hutchins. What a wonderful mutually supportive team they made. Continue reading...
sources.title: Margaret Busby: ‘My friend Bonnie Greer fearlessly spoke out and forged connections’

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Writer and critic who became known for her sharp, composed appearances on TV shows such as Late Review and Question Time The writing and broadcasting of Bonnie Greer, who has died aged 77, were driven by divided perspectives. Her technical experience across an unusual range of genres – drama, fiction, biography, memoir, documentary – informed her work as a wry and lively critic, especially on the late-night BBC2 cultural programmes Late Review and Newsnight Review from the 1990s onwards. And, having spent the first half of her life in the US and the second in the UK, she was also perfectly positioned – in an era when British writers, movie-makers and artists were making much work about and for America – to adjudicate on such creative duality, as well as the escalating Americanisation of British politics. Another asset was her connections: reviewing a David Mamet play or a Madonna album, she had worked with the former in Chicago theatre and met the latter as a young music wannabe in a Manhattan apartment share. 作家邦妮葛瑞爾辭世

美裔英籍作家兼文化評論人邦妮．葛瑞爾辭世，享壽 77 歲。她曾在 BBC2 的文化節目《Late Review》與《Newsnight Review》擔任犀利的常態來賓，也橫跨小說、劇本、回憶錄與紀錄片等多種創作領域。作家瑪格麗特．巴斯比追憶，形容她「勇敢發聲、廣結善緣」。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 17 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
美裔英籍作家兼文化評論人邦妮．葛瑞爾（Bonnie Greer）辭世，享壽 77 歲。她的創作橫跨小說、劇本、回憶錄與紀錄片，也曾在 BBC2 的文化節目《Late Review》與《Newsnight Review》擔任犀利的常態來賓。她人生前半在美國芝加哥度過，後半輩子落腳倫敦，這樣橫跨兩地的背景，讓她評論英美文化交融的作品時格外有洞察力。作家瑪格麗特．巴斯比追憶她，形容她「勇敢發聲、廣結善緣」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 17 日發佈的報導。
voice_text:
作家兼文化評論人邦妮．葛瑞爾過世了，享壽 77 歲。

她的創作橫跨小說、劇本、回憶錄與紀錄片，也曾在電視文化節目上擔任犀利的常態來賓。她人生前半在美國芝加哥度過，後半輩子落腳倫敦，這樣橫跨兩地的背景，讓她評論英美文化交融的作品時格外有洞察力。朋友追憶她，形容她勇敢發聲、廣結善緣。
